name: Tongtai Machine & Tool Co., Ltd.
summary: Tongtai Machine & Tool Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells machine tools, computer components, computer numerical control lathes, and cutting centers in Taiwan, China, Europe, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Machine Manufacturer, Component Manufacturer, and Others segments. The company offers vertical, horizontal, vertical 5-axis, horizontal 5-axis, and ultra sonic assisted machining center, as well as tapping center, and horizontal and vertical CNC lathe; and CNC PCB drilling, CNC PCB Routing, and laser processing machine.
